sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Current: left at (39, 19), right at (44, 34)
# Both squares are blocked from moving up at current columns
# Left neck is at cols 14-18, right neck is at cols 49-53
# Need to align squares with necks before moving up

# Try LEFT to move left square to neck cols (14-18)
result = action(['LEFT'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
blues = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'S':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = (min([p[0] for p in b]), max([p[0] for p in b]))
        cols = (min([p[1] for p in b]), max([p[1] for p in b]))
        blues.append((rows, cols))
blues.sort(key=lambda x: x[1][0])  # sort by col
print(f"After LEFT: left={blues[0]}, right={blues[1]}")

# Now try UP - left square should be able to move through neck at col 14
result = action(['UP'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
blues = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'S':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = (min([p[0] for p in b]), max([p[0] for p in b]))
        cols = (min([p[1] for p in b]), max([p[1] for p in b]))
        blues.append((rows, cols))
blues.sort(key=lambda x: x[1][0])
print(f"After UP: left={blues[0]}, right={blues[1]}")
print(f"level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")

# Continue UP to get left square to top
for i in range(5):
    result = action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    blues = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = (min([p[0] for p in b]), max([p[0] for p in b]))
            cols = (min([p[1] for p in b]), max([p[1] for p in b]))
            blues.append((rows, cols))
    blues.sort(key=lambda x: x[1][0])
    print(f"After UP: left={blues[0]}, right={blues[1]}")
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
